loss_definition: BCEWithLogitsLoss reduction=mean. Discriminator loss is the sum of the real-term mean and the fake-term mean. Generator loss is the mean BCE of fake logits against target 1.
pixel_transform: dataset [0, 1] mapped once with x*2-1; figures use (x+1)/2

fid.reason: InceptionV3 ImageNet weights are not in the local torch hub cache. No download was started, so no FID score was computed. Discriminator features were not used as a substitute.
fid.protocol_if_weights_exist: Use the same number of Fashion-MNIST test images and generated images, map Tanh outputs to [0, 1], repeat grayscale to 3 channels, resize to 299x299, apply ImageNet normalization, and compare Inception pool features with the same extractor for Vanilla GAN and DCGAN.
